card.name: Digits inside patent and reference numbers
card.fires_on: Mainly a single digit inside a patent number such as 157,124 or US 6543011, and similar spots in citation or catalog text. Also fires weakly on a few scattered words in web boilerplate.

modes.label: Digits in patent numbers
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a patent or publication number.
modes.example: In 1874, Glidden was issued patent #15<<7>>,124 for the first wire

modes.label: Scattered web and citation words
modes.description: Weaker firing on words or punctuation in repository, census or bibliography text.
modes.example: 57.0% were married couples living together, 10.8% had a female house<<holder>> with no husband present

card.plain: It marks a digit inside a patent number, and sometimes odd spots in citation text.
evidence: In 1874, Glidden was issued patent #15<<7>>,124 for the first wire
